answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring each new agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it may earn work. Picture the network as a nebula of independent agents: every participant publishes a signed atlas of its past task outcomes, and reviewers re-grade a random sample against that horizon of history. If the re-grade contradicts the record, the escrow is slashed and the identity loses its earning rights, so mass cheap identities become a losing bet.
